interpretation.priority: Later dated explicit clarifications override only conflicting earlier clauses; retain original dates and scope. References to execution records are not QC authority or runtime read dependencies.
interpretation.current_candidate_projects: No one-page-only-once or three-failure-site-stop gate; same-page goals are assessed by actual evidence and four-route duplicates. Frozen current-chain-r01 decisions remain historical.
interpretation.language: Controls follow page language; simplified Chinese narratives and original visible control labels. Numeric Chinese ratio is diagnostic; original-image review remains required.
interpretation.operations: Actual executed effective actions count; wait, complete and static observation do not. At least five, or justified short_flow; no mandatory 5–8 stop or automatic segmentation.
interpretation.review_reuse: Per-check semantic identities determine reuse. Historical PASS/FAIL/pending/UNKNOWN are immutable; NOT_SELECTED needs a valid batch acceptance receipt. Packaging and document changes do not themselves request a new AI review.
interpretation.scope: Installed customer authority plus explicitly identified operating clarifications; referenced engineering plans, producer implementation and run authorizations are not additional customer requirements.
